what: Items lined up horizontally (bottles, product cutouts) form an endless loop. With no document scroll, wheel (×1.15) and drag (×1.5, release velocity ×190 as inertia) set a target position and the loop follows with exponential damping (2.3, 11 while dragging). One item per screen width/4 cell (gap .92, width .616 — on phones a /3 cell, gap 1.15, width .84). Items scale .55→1.35 and brighten .7→1.1 as they approach center, blur with distance (up to 4px), tilt ±18° on a sin wave and stagger slightly up and down. When spinning fast they tilt the opposite way, shrink slightly and blur. Items around the cursor are pulled 16px by a Gaussian weight (1.6× width), tilt 5° and lift 5% (spring 70, damping 9). On entry they float up from 56px below in 1.15s
ease: Exponential decay 1 − e^(−2.3·dt) · entrance ease-out cubic

options.gap: Gap relative to cell width, default .92 (×1.25 on phone)
options.size: Width of one item relative to the cell width, default .616 · phone size-phone .8395
options.damp: Follow damping, default 2.3 · while dragging damp-drag 11
options.[data-fx-part=item]: Children (links, cards) placed on the ring. is-center is added when one gets near the center slot

note: The ring eats the wheel (preventDefault), so place it in a one-screen Hero with no document scroll. Touch accepts only horizontal drag and doesn’t block vertical scroll (touch-action: pan-y). The original wraps the bottle label onto a WebGL cylinder and rotates it together, but that belongs to the site (jar-carousel-product-brand jars.js) so it isn’t included in this part
